notes: Counts: batch 3 READY 3, NEEDS_CONFIGURATION 2, NOT_COMPATIBLE 5; batch 4 READY 1, NEEDS_CONFIGURATION 4, NOT_COMPATIBLE 5. REPO_INVALID: none.

Deviation: git HEAD at start was 4cb79253cd6b638019a58a3b06aceec1368b5a95, not the tested commit; testedCommit in the files is the value given by the coordinator (e6a3b58ee2363923fef21faca86611fa3bf84538), as in final-01.yaml.

Unclear rule R1/R4: worker. "Declared separate worker process" does not say whether a supervisord program that the image CMD already starts counts. Applied: worker true only when a separate command must be started that the image does not start (Procfile or compose service). linkding, pretix, snipe-it and similar are worker false.

Unclear rule R4: redis and worker for optional features. microblog (repo-524) uses Redis and rq only for the export-posts feature; applied R4 optional, so redis false and worker false (both earlier labels said true).

Unclear rule R5: FluentMigrator (nopCommerce), Flyway (komga), sqlx (atuin), goose (navidrome) and the pocketbase migrate command (registered in examples/base/main.go) are treated as migration tools or named commands, so migration true. Hibernate hbm2ddl (hapi-fhir) and schema created by the server (parse-server, electric) are opaque in-app schema creation, so migration omitted.

Unclear rule: monorepo has no definition in R1. Used: the repository holds several packages or modules next to the target app (Cargo workspace for atuin, Gradle modules for komga, yarn workspaces for actual and excalidraw, pnpm workspace for electric).
Unclear rule R7: excalidraw final image is static nginx; R7 has no nginx or static value. Used node (build runtime).

Unclear rule R6: when the verdict has two causes (for example no buildable Dockerfile and SQLite or a data directory), the family for the local-state cause is listed; the missing-Dockerfile or failing-Dockerfile cause adds no entry. Applied to komga, pocketbase and electric.

Unclear rule R1: snipe-it (repo-529) is a close call between NOT_COMPATIBLE and NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. The image declares VOLUME /var/lib/snipeit for keys, backups and uploads; an S3 disk removes only uploads. Kept NOT_COMPATIBLE.
Unclear rule R1: dufs (repo-522) image starts with no arguments and serves its working directory, but its purpose is the mounted data directory passed as an argument. Kept NOT_COMPATIBLE.
R3 applied to snipe-it: verify listed unsupported mysql; MySQL 8.0 is supported and the app is not MariaDB-only, so no mysql entry.

Where initial or verify omitted storage or migration and the source has no S3 requirement or migration tool, the final omits the key; reconciliation lists initial false versus verify omitted as a difference.

Inputs read: only the permitted files (label-rules.md, initial/verify 03 and 04, final-01.yaml for shape, slice-03.json, slice-04.json, manifest.ts, normalize.ts lines 25-45, mvp-scope.md grep for Redis lines only) and pinned GitHub source. No Deployz output, no holdout, no other label file. Nothing outside the permitted list.
Scratch files (trees, fetched sources, generator) are in the session scratchpad p1-reconcile-02/. No containers started. No git state changed; no commit.
